data.body: CROSS-EPIC COORDINATION from 411b-a047-18de-4516 SC7: 411b adds mutation-testing configuration logic to plugins/dso/scripts/create-dso-app.sh — when scaffolding a new DSO-using project, writes default mutation.<stack>.enabled=true for detected stacks, copies mutation-testing.yml alongside other CI workflow templates, adds tickets-branch push permission to CI auth section. Coordination: if d765-a3b6's Strata-aware rewrite of create-dso-app.sh ships first, the rewrite must preserve 411b's mutation-testing hooks. If 411b ships first, d765-a3b6's rewrite inherits these hooks. Not a hard dependency in either direction.
